name: rating-group
title: Rating Group
description: A star rating input with hover preview, half-star support, and keyboard navigation.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value of the rating when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the rating.

props.name: form
props.description: The associate form of the underlying input element.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the rating. Useful for composition.

props.name: name
props.description: The name attribute of the rating element (used in forms).

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the rating

events.name: onHoverChange
events.description: Function to be called when the rating value is hovered.

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Function to be called when the rating value changes.

examples.title: Basic
examples.source:
import RatingGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/rating-group/rating-group.marko";

<RatingGroup label="Rate this" defaultValue=3/>
examples.description: A star rating with an initial value, uncontrolled.

examples.title: Half stars
examples.source:
import RatingGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/rating-group/rating-group.marko";

<RatingGroup label="Rate this" defaultValue=3.5 allowHalf/>
examples.description: Pass `allowHalf` to accept and render 0.5 increments.

examples.title: Custom count
examples.source:
import RatingGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/rating-group/rating-group.marko";

<RatingGroup label="Out of 10" count=10 defaultValue=7/>
examples.description: The `count` prop sets how many items render, independent of the value scale.

examples.title: Readonly
examples.source:
import RatingGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/rating-group/rating-group.marko";

<RatingGroup label="Average rating" defaultValue=4.5 allowHalf readOnly/>
examples.description: A `readOnly` rating displays a value without accepting hover or click input.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.source:
import RatingGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/rating-group/rating-group.marko";

<RatingGroup label="Rate this" defaultValue=2 disabled/>
examples.description: A disabled rating is skipped by the tab order and ignores pointer input.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import RatingGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/rating-group/rating-group.marko";
Selected: ${value}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`, or use Marko's bind shorthand `value:=state`.
